ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: \textbf{Definition:} A convex quadrilateral in which one pair of opposite sides is equal and the other pair is unequal is called an "equilateral quadrilateral". As shown in the figure, in $Rt\triangle PBC$, $\angle PCB=90^\circ$, point A is on side BP, and point D is on side CP. If $BC=11$, $\tan\angle PBC=\frac{12}{5}$, $AB=13$, and quadrilateral ABCD is an "equilateral quadrilateral", then what is the length of CD?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, the position of point D is illustrated as follows: \\
(1) If $CD=AB$, at this time point D is at the position $D_{1}$, $CD_{1}=AB=13$; \\
(2) If $AD=BC=11$, at this time point D is at the positions $D_{2}$, $D_{3}$, $AD_{2}=AD_{3}=BC=11$, \\
Through point A, draw $AE\perp BC$, $AF\perp PC$, with E and F as the feet of the perpendiculars, respectively, \\
Let $BE=x$, \\
$\because$ $\tan \angle PBC = \frac{12}{5}$, \\
$\therefore$ $AE=\frac{12}{5}x$, \\
In $\triangle ABE$, $AE^{2}+BE^{2}=AB^{2}$, \\
i.e., $x^{2}+\left(\frac{12}{5}x\right)^{2}=13^{2}$, \\
Solving yields: $x_{1}=5$, $x_{2}=-5$ (discard), \\
$\therefore$ $BE=5$, $AE=12$, \\
$\therefore$ $CE=BC-BE=6$, \\
Since quadrilateral $AECF$ is a rectangle, we have $AF=CE=6$, $CF=AE=12$, \\
In $\triangle AFD_{2}$, $FD_{2}=\sqrt{AD_{2}^{2}-AF^{2}}=\sqrt{85}$, \\
$\therefore$ $CD_{2}=CF-FD_{2}=12-\sqrt{85}$, \\
$CD_{3}=CF+FD_{2}=12+\sqrt{85}$, \\
In summary, the length of CD can be $13$, $12-\sqrt{85}$, or $12+\sqrt{85}$. \\
Hence, the answer is: $\boxed{13}$, $12-\sqrt{85}$, or $12+\sqrt{85}$.

推理：按指定解析几何方法，取 C 为原点，CP 为正 x 轴，BC 为正 y 轴，则 C=(0,0)，B=(0,11)，D=(t,0)，其中 t=CD。因为 tan∠PBC=12/5，所以从 B 沿 BP 向 P 走时，水平位移与竖直下降的比例为 12:5。又 AB=13，对应 5-12-13 直角三角形步长，因此从 B 到 A 的水平位移为 12，竖直下降为 5，所以 A=(12,6)。

四边形 ABCD 的两组对边是 AB 与 CD、BC 与 AD。题意要求恰有一组对边相等。

第一种：若 AB=CD，则 CD=13，即 t=13。

第二种：若 BC=AD，则 AD=11。由 A=(12,6)，D=(t,0)，得 AD^2=(t-12)^2+(0-6)^2=11^2，所以 (t-12)^2+36=121，(t-12)^2=85，因此 t=12±sqrt(85)。

推理：按指定解析几何方法，取 C 为原点，CP 为正 x 轴，BC 为正 y 轴，则 C=(0,0)，B=(0,11)，D=(t,0)，其中 t=CD。因为 tan∠PBC=12/5，所以从 B 沿 BP 向 P 走时，水平位移与竖直下降的比例为 12:5。又 AB=13，对应 5-12-13 直角三角形步长，因此从 B 到 A 的水平位移为 12，竖直下降为 5，所以 A=(12,6)。

四边形 ABCD 的两组对边是 AB 与 CD、BC 与 AD。题意要求恰有一组对边相等。

第一种：若 AB=CD，则 CD=13，即 t=13。

第二种：若 BC=AD，则 AD=11。由 A=(12,6)，D=(t,0)，得 AD^2=(t-12)^2+(0-6)^2=11^2，所以 (t-12)^2+36=121，(t-12)^2=85，因此 t=12±sqrt(85)。

还需确认 D 在 CP 上。由 tan∠PBC=PC/BC=12/5，且 BC=11，得 PC=132/5=26.4。三个值 13、12-sqrt(85)、12+sqrt(85) 都在 0 到 132/5 之间，因此均有效。最终答案：CD 可以为 13、12-sqrt(85)、12+sqrt(85)。

Thus A is 12 units horizontally from BC and 6 units above CP, so AC=sqrt(12^2+6^2)=6sqrt(5). Also the angle between CA and CD has cosine 12/(6sqrt(5))=2/sqrt(5), since CD lies along CP. For the equilateral-quadrilateral condition, either AB=CD, giving CD=13 immediately, or BC=AD, giving AD=11. raw_record.original_question: Definition: A convex quadrilateral in which one pair of opposite sides is equal and the other pair is unequal is called an "equilateral quadrilateral". As shown in the figure, in $Rt\triangle PBC$, $\angle PCB=90^\circ$, point A is on side BP, and point D is on side CP. If $BC=11$, $\tan\angle PBC=\frac{12}{5}$, $AB=13$, and quadrilateral $ABCD$ is an "equilateral quadrilateral", then what is the length of $CD$?
raw_record.answer:
Solution: As shown in the diagram, the position of point $D$ is illustrated as follows:
(1) If $CD=AB$, then point $D$ is at position $D_{1}$, and $CD_{1}=AB=13$;
(2) If $AD=BC=11$, then point $D$ is at positions $D_{2}$ or $D_{3}$, with $AD_{2}=AD_{3}=BC=11$.
Through point $A$, draw $AE\perp BC$ and $AF\perp PC$, with $E$ and $F$ as the feet of the perpendiculars, respectively.
Let $BE=x$.
Because $\tan \angle PBC = \frac{12}{5}$, we have $AE=\frac{12}{5}x$.
In $\triangle ABE$, $AE^{2}+BE^{2}=AB^{2}$, i.e.,
$x^{2}+\left(\frac{12}{5}x\right)^{2}=13^{2}$.
Solving yields $x_{1}=5$, $x_{2}=-5$ (discard), so $BE=5$, $AE=12$.
Thus $CE=BC-BE=6$.
Since quadrilateral $AECF$ is a rectangle, $AF=CE=6$ and $CF=AE=12$.
In $\triangle AFD_{2}$, $FD_{2}=\sqrt{AD_{2}^{2}-AF^{2}}=\sqrt{85}$.
Therefore $CD_{2}=CF-FD_{2}=12-\sqrt{85}$, and $CD_{3}=CF+FD_{2}=12+\sqrt{85}$.
In summary, the length of $CD$ can be $13$, $12-\sqrt{85}$, or $12+\sqrt{85}$.
